title: Companies Act, 2013 — private-company meeting exemptions under section 462

content.publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India
content.citation: Notification G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, read with G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, and corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017
content.verificationStatus: IndiaCode reproduction checked; official MCA primary PDFs not independently retrieved in this pass
content.note: Scoped source check: the India Code-recorded reproduction of G.S.R. 464(E), 5 June 2015, lists Chapter VII sections 101–107 and section 109 and states they apply unless otherwise specified in the respective section or the company’s articles provide otherwise. The reproduced G.S.R. 583(E), 13 June 2017, inserts paragraph 2A making the table’s exceptions, modifications and adaptations applicable only to a private company that has not defaulted in filing financial statements under section 137 or annual returns under section 92; corrigendum S.O. 2218(E), 13 July 2017, corrects the wording of that paragraph. The India Code page expressly says the Department’s PDF remains authoritative; the official parliamentary record confirms the 2017 notification and corrigendum were laid before the House but does not replace the Gazette text. The official MCA PDF URLs are retained, but their primary text was not independently retrieved in this pass. Verify current notification text, later amendments, company filing eligibility and articles before applying any modification. Source review is not final legal sign-off.
